newsitem.title: USA: CME Nov lumber ends lower, January up $15 limit.
newsitem.headline: CME Nov lumber ends lower, January up $15 limit.

text.p: CME November lumber futures closed down $9.40 per tbf while January closed up the $15.00 expanded limit with about 300 limit bids remaining at the close.
Profittaking and scattered talk of some quota relief for Canadian lumber shippers prompted selling in the November, analysts said.
Also, traders said the transfer of long November positions to January had begun.
Gains in January also were tied to talk that the Canadian quota restrictions may also keep supplies of deliverable spruce tight through that contract's delivery period.
Lumber closed down $9.40 to up $15.00 per tbf with November off the most at $468.10 and January was up $15.00 at $419.40.
